title: af/TaskExecutionStarted@1
description: The marker that a lease began kernel execution of its Task (ADR-0153, design §5 "Retained history"): the payload of the Task log's own event kind `TaskExecutionStarted@1`, beside `TaskTransition@5`, whose shape it leaves unchanged (ADR-0145). The Task runtime commits it once per lease, before anything else it does under that lease; it references no artifact, never changes the Task's result, names the lease (`writer`, `epoch`) judged against the Task's current lease as a transition's is, and the Store refuses it on a finished Task. A lease that only planned (`af task start` without `--execute`), decided, refreshed or swept writes none, so the markers before a lease count exactly the executions before it; Telemetry numbers a run's executions from them. It is written identically at every telemetry level.
